queryLines:
WITH latest AS (SELECT date_set_id FROM __CATALOG__.gold.vw_powerbi_date_set_quality WHERE publication_state = 'published' AND power_bi_refresh_ready = true ORDER BY completed_at DESC LIMIT 1),
base AS (SELECT r.* FROM __CATALOG__.gold.vw_powerbi_region_kpi_published r INNER JOIN latest USING (date_set_id)),
ranked AS (SELECT b.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY registered_bev_passenger_car_stock DESC, analysis_region_code) AS bev_rank FROM base b),
benchmarks AS (SELECT PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS median_points, PERCENTILE(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs, 0.5) AS median_fast FROM base)
SELECT 'Germany' AS geography, COUNT(*) AS analysis_regions, SUM(registered_bev_passenger_car_stock) AS registered_bevs, SUM(registered_passenger_car_stock) AS registered_passenger_cars, CAST(100.0 * SUM(registered_bev_passenger_car_stock) / SUM(registered_passenger_car_stock) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS national_bev_penetration_percent, SUM(in_service_registered_charging_points) AS in_service_points, SUM(in_service_registered_normal_charging_points) AS in_service_normal_points, SUM(in_service_registered_fast_charging_points) AS in_service_fast_points, CAST(MAX(median_points) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_points_per_1000_bevs, CAST(MAX(median_fast) AS DECIMAL(18,4)) AS median_fast_points_per_1000_bevs, SUM(CASE WHEN bev_rank <= 100 AND in_service_registered_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_points AND in_service_registered_fast_charging_points_per_1000_bevs < median_fast THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_bev_below_both FROM ranked CROSS JOIN benchmarks
